title: Star-Ordered Rotor Loops in Clifford Algebras
summary: We consider, in a real Clifford algebra, a family of unit bivectors $B_i = C S_i$ formed from $k+1$ pairwise anticommuting generators $C, S_1, \ldots, S_k$ with square $-1$; we call this a \emph{star family} with \emph{central generator} $C$ and \emph{leaf generators} $S_i$. For the associated rotors $U_i(θ_i) = \cos\frac{θ_i}{2} + B_i \sin\frac{θ_i}{2}$ we study two objects: the ordered chain $P_k = U_1 \cdots U_k$ and the \emph{star-ordered rotor loop} $Θ_k = P_k \, Q_k$ with the \emph{same-order reversion product} $Q_k = \widetilde U_1 \cdots \widetilde U_k$, as opposed to the trivially…
